label: Jugular Venous Oxygen Saturation
definition: A measurement of the oxygen saturation in the blood returning from the brain, used to assess cerebral oxygenation.

label: Outcome Data
definition: Data related to the results or consequences of medical treatment or intervention.

label: Brain Injury
definition: A condition resulting from damage to the brain, often requiring intensive medical management.

label: Arterial Oxygen Saturation
definition: A non-invasive method used to measure the oxygen saturation level in the blood.

label: Clinical Research Form
definition: A document used for recording data on adverse events during clinical trials.

label: Neurological Injury
definition: An injury that affects the nervous system, which may include the brain and spinal cord.

label: Transcranial Doppler
definition: A non-invasive ultrasound method used to measure blood flow velocity in the brain's blood vessels.

label: Respiratory Distress Syndrome
definition: A condition that can complicate the management of patients with traumatic brain injury.

label: Management
definition: The process of administering medical care and treatment to patients.

label: Injuries
definition: Physical damage to the body resulting from external force or trauma.

label: Non-Invasive Blood Pressure
definition: Non-invasive blood pressure, an optional BrainIT parameter.

label: Brain Tissue Oxygen
definition: A measurement of the oxygen level in brain tissue, used to assess cerebral oxygenation.

label: Substance Abuse
definition: The harmful or hazardous use of psychoactive substances, including alcohol and illicit drugs.

label: Coma
definition: A state of prolonged unconsciousness where a person cannot be awakened and fails to respond to stimuli.

label: Error
definition: An identified issue in the recorded medical data.

label: Central Venous Pressure
definition: A physiological parameter measuring the pressure in the thoracic vena cava, reflecting right atrial pressure.

label: Head Injury
definition: An injury to the head that may involve damage to the brain and has significant social and economic consequences.

label: Machine
definition: A device used in medical evaluations to record observations.

label: End-Tidal Carbon Dioxide
definition: A measurement of the concentration of carbon dioxide in exhaled air, used to assess ventilation.

label: Reading
definition: A recorded value of a parameter observed at a specific timepoint.

label: Provenance
definition: Information about the entities and processes involved in producing observations.
